input.quote: Customer will not assign this Agreement or any of its rights hereunder without the prior written consent of IBM, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
input.rationale: Section 14.10 binds only Customer: we need IBM's consent for any assignment outside the narrow merger/consolidation/acquisition carve-out (so even an intra-group affiliate transfer or a sale of substantially all assets requires consent), while IBM is unrestricted and could assign the Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours. That asymmetry fails even the fallback, which requires consent for every non-successor assignment on both sides. The redline leaves our general consent sentence and the not-unreasonably-withheld standard untouched, widens the existing "Notwithstanding" carve-out to affiliates and asset sales, and adds the IBM-side consent requirement, absolute competitor bar, and confirmation that a change of control of Bluefly gives IBM no termination right (no such right exists today, so that sentence is confirmatory).

mappings.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.

proposal.summary: Keep our general consent sentence; extend the existing carve-out to affiliates and asset sales, and add IBM-side consent, no-competitor and no-change-of-control-termination language.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the existing carve-out so we may assign to an affiliate or a successor (including a sale of substantially all assets) without IBM's consent, and added the reciprocal position: IBM may not assign without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor of ours, and our change of control gives IBM no termination right. The general consent requirement on us is unchanged.

ops.oldText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to a successor organization by merger, consolidation or acquisition.
ops.newText: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer may assign this Agreement to an affiliate or a successor organization by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.

ops.text: IBM will not assign this Agreement without Customer's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and will not assign to a competitor of Customer. A change of control of Customer will not give IBM any right to terminate this Agreement.
